messages:
zara: Quick readiness check for mist-65b-v2 onboarding — weights uploaded, tokenizer present, and we want to validate max_context / KV cache sizing before we flip traffic. Can folks confirm risks and owners?

liam: I pulled the weights: s3://rw-models/mist-65b-v2/weights/ (sharded). size matches expected ~420GB. QA smoke to run on a 2xA100 node first.

maya: Tokenizer file at s3://rw-models/mist-65b-v2/tokenizer.json. Noticed some merged symbols that could change token counts for long sequences. I'll run a tokenization diff against our reference prompts.

noah: Config draft in infra repo: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/PR-4321 — key bits:
```
model.name: mist-65b-v2
model.max_context: 131072
kv_cache_format: kvv2
quantization: int8
weight_paths:
  - s3://rw-models/mist-65b-v2/weights/shard-*.bin
batch_policy: latency-50ms
```
We need to validate memory headroom for 128k+ contexts.

liam: Quick note: KV cache mem ~= (num_layers * d_kv * seq_len * 2) rough ballpark. For mist-65b-v2 I estimate ~48GB of KV at 131k ctx (per worker) before quantization savings — we should double-check with the exact dims.

maya: Tokenizer diffs look minor for normal prompts, but longform edgecases (repeats + lots of whitespace) increase token count ~3-4% vs reference which pushes us closer to OOM on the smaller node shapes. I'll attach examples in the PR.

zara: Who can run a full memory smoke (seq=64k and seq=131k) with kvv2 + int8 config on staging Dedicated? Want numbers for peak GPU mem and host page faults.

liam: I can run seq=64k today. For seq=131k I need a 512GB GPU node (ask infra). Scheduling now — pinging infra-bot.

infra-bot: @liam request received: provision request for 1x p4d.24xlarge-like node (512GB GPU mem) on staging. ETA ~3h. Request ID: RB-78902.

noah: Meanwhile I'll add a config validation check to the deploy pipeline to block max_context > hw_max when kv_cache_format=kvv2 unless explicit ack is set. PR attached to PR-4321.

sophia: Heads-up on routing: if we enable 131k contexts we should set a fallback route to mist-65b-v1 (64k) when we detect insufficient capacity — automatic fallback is already wired but needs a model alias mapping. I'll update the routing table.

zara: OK plan: liam runs seq=64k smoke and posts GPU mem traces. infra-bot will provision for 131k run, liam will run it once available. maya will post tokenizer examples + delta. noah will add config gate. sophia will update routing alias. We'll regroup async here after results. Thanks :thumbsup:

liam: starting seq=64k smoke now — will paste logs.

maya: added tokenizer diffs to PR-4321 comments. examples: long-repeats.txt + whitespace-heavy.txt

noah: config gate PR up for review — @zara @liam can you quick-review? simple check, should be quick.

sophia: routing alias updated: mist-65b -> mist-65b-v1 (fallback) in routing service. tested locally.

liam: seq=64k run done: peak GPU memory 398GB, KV region ~22.5GB, total GPU reserved ~420GB, no page faults. Logs:```
[smoke] seq=65536 steps=3 peak_gpu_mem=398432MB kv_mem=23040MB host_pf=0
```
Posting full trace to PR.

zara: Solid. If 131k run confirms linear scaling we're probably safe on large node but we should flag this for Dedicated pricing discussion. I'll add a note to the onboarding checklist to include max_context smoke numbers.

liam: infra-bot says node provisioned, will kick off the 131k run in ~10m.

infra-bot: Provision complete: RB-78902 -> node-ss-14 available.

liam: 131k run started. Quick preview: OOM at step 2 on a 4-GPU shard setup. Looks like our shard distribution underestimates per-GPU KV due to uneven weight splits. Dumping per-GPU mem: GPU0 132GB, GPU1 120GB, GPU2 134GB, GPU3 140GB -> GPU3 hit alloc limit.

maya: that matches tokenizer delta — extra tokens pushed one shard over. We should either rebalance shards or lower per-GPU max_context.

noah: I'll patch the shard planner to prefer even KV allocation and add a safety clamp: max_context_per_gpu = floor(hw_gpu_mem / estimated_kv_per_seq). Pushing small fix now.

zara: Great. Action items tracked in PR-4321: liam (full mem traces + logs), maya (tokenizer examples + token deltas), noah (shard planner fix + deploy gate), sophia (routing alias + fallback test). Reopen thread once 131k passes. Thanks everyone.
